newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux traffic Nov 96 traffic up 7pct.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux traffic Nov 96 traffic up 7pct.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it flew 187.6 million freight tonne kilometres, FTK, in November 1996, up seven percent on the same month the previous year.
During January-November 1996, the Luxembourg-based cargo airline flew a total of 1.83 billion FTK, an increase of four percent on 1995 levels.

Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-400Fs and three Boeing 747-200Fs as well as an additional 747-200F on leaseback. It is due to take delivery of a fourth 747-400F in August 1997. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706
